description: Bridge Builder 2 / Bridge Construction Set (Chronic Logic 2004, German Halycon release, via Proton)
long: Bridge Builder 2, also known as Bridge Construction Set, is a physics-based bridge-engineering puzzle game. Players design and build bridges within a budget, then test whether their structures can bear the weight of crossing trains and vehicles. It is a sequel to Chronic Logic's Pontifex/Bridge Builder line.
